name: hackathon-platform
description: Universal hackathon starter: 1 frontend + 3 backends (auth, main, ai-storage), wired end-to-end with JWT, Redis, Supabase, MongoDB, and Azure Blob.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n auth,main,ai,web -c blue,green,magenta,yellow "npm --prefix services/auth-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/main-service run dev" "npm --prefix services/ai-storage-service run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix services/auth-service && npm install --prefix services/main-service && npm install --prefix services/ai-storage-service && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/auth-service test && npm --prefix services/main-service test && npm --prefix services/ai-storage-service test
scripts.lint: npm --prefix services/auth-service run lint && npm --prefix services/main-service run lint && npm --prefix services/ai-storage-service run lint && npm --prefix frontend run lint
